title: Hoffman's team of mathematicians working on trace-logic conjectures

tellings.quote: So there are so we're assembling a team right now of of mathematicians. We have all these conjectures that we've put out publicly conjectures

plain: In 2026, the cognitive scientist Donald Hoffman was putting together a team of mathematicians to work on conjectures that come out of his mathematical theory of consciousness, which he calls trace logic. He tells Michels the conjectures have already been published so others can work on them too. For Hoffman, proving them would help show that the reality we see is not the whole of what exists.
